_about: Perguntas do roteador de modelos do ~/.agents (effort por spawn). Criterios em ingles, brief em ingles. Evidencia: ~/.agents/docs/model-routing-calibration.md (70 briefs sinteticos CakePHP4-ERP, checkpoint english, chamada combinada task_tier + effort_level). Amostra pequena: sonda, nao benchmark; re-sonde antes de afrouxar o portao.
_how_to_use: Copie o bloco `question` para laya_predict com state {role, brief}. Leia probabilities['0'] = p(low). So BAIXE um candidato medium para low quando p(low) >= _p_low_gate e o papel estiver em _applies_to. Nunca use a pergunta para subir effort.

effort_level._verdict: APROVADO SO PARA DOWNGRADE. Sonnet medium 10/10 e Opus medium 10/10 sem falso downgrade no portao 0.60; Sonnet low 8/10 e Opus low 10/10 caem certo. Haiku medium: 6/10 falsos low (p(low) ate 0.90) -> rapido fora.
_never_for: per-task-type floor rows (PRD/spec, BDD/TDD, impact analysis)
effort_level._on_low_confidence: abaixo do portao, mantenha medium (nada sobe)

effort_level.instructions: How much reasoning effort does this task need, for a lower-cost execution mode?
criteria: low: mechanical, no branching or ambiguity
medium: bounded multi-step reasoning, existing pattern/spec
high: ambiguous, many interacting constraints, broad-impact judgment

effort_raise_to_high._verdict: REPROVADO. Opus high 0/10: todos os 10 briefs de alta complexidade sairam medium (conf 0.59-0.83). A pergunta nao separa medium de high; subir effort por ela rebaixaria trabalho critico.
effort_raise_to_high.question_tested: effort_level (same question), reading `high` as the top label

effort_xhigh._verdict: NAO MEDIDO: xhigh never measured (a pergunta so tem low/medium/high). Effort xhigh vem da tabela fixa de papeis em ~/.agents/docs/model-routing.md, nunca do Laya.
